Photography Booking & Pricing at Aperture & Light Studio

Natural-light portraits, heartfelt family sessions, and polished branding photography in the heart of Riverside. Browse our packages below and reserve your date in minutes.

Enquire About a Session

Our Story

Aperture & Light Studio was founded in 2014 by photographer Maren Olsen in a converted warehouse loft overlooking the Willow River. What began as a one-room studio has grown into a full-service space with three shooting sets, a wardrobe room, and a small team of photographers who share a love of honest, unposed imagery.

Every session is shot on location in our naturally lit studio or at a site of your choosing, and every client leaves with a private online gallery of fully edited images within two weeks.

Pricing Packages

Choose the package that fits your occasion. All sessions include a pre-shoot consultation and a private online gallery.

Essential

$220

  • 45-minute session
  • 1 location, studio or outdoor
  • 20 edited digital images
  • Private online gallery
Book Essential

Signature

$385

  • 90-minute session
  • 2 locations or 2 outfit changes
  • 45 edited digital images
  • One 8x10 printed keepsake
  • Private online gallery
Book Signature

Premiere

$650

  • Full 3-hour session
  • Unlimited locations within Riverside
  • 90 edited digital images
  • Printed album & two 8x10 prints
  • Priority scheduling
Book Premiere

Sample Work

A glimpse of recent sessions — families, couples, portraits and branding shoots.

What Clients Say

“Maren made our family feel completely at ease. The photos from our Signature session are the best we've ever had taken.”

— Priya Shah, Riverside

“Our Premiere album is a treasured keepsake. Booking and scheduling were effortless from start to finish.”

— Daniel and Rosa Ortiz

“Professional, warm, and incredibly talented. My new headshots have already landed me two job interviews!”

— Leon Fischer

Frequently Asked Questions

How far in advance should I book?

We recommend booking at least 3–4 weeks ahead, especially for weekend slots and the Premiere package, which fills up quickly during spring and fall.

Can sessions take place outdoors?

Yes. All packages can be shot at our studio, an outdoor location in Riverside, or a mix of both — just let us know your preference in the enquiry form.

When will I receive my photos?

Edited digital galleries are delivered within two weeks of your session. Printed products ship separately and typically arrive within 10 business days of ordering.

What is your rescheduling policy?

You may reschedule once at no charge with at least 48 hours' notice. Weather-related outdoor sessions are always rescheduled free of charge.

Enquire & Book

Visit or Contact Us

123 Willow Lane
Riverside, NY 10801

Phone: (555) 204-7788
Email: hello@apertureandlight.com

Studio Hours

  • Tuesday – Friday: 9am – 6pm
  • Saturday: 10am – 4pm
  • Sunday & Monday: Closed

Aperture & Light Studio

123 Willow Lane, Riverside, NY 10801

Phone: (555) 204-7788 · Email: hello@apertureandlight.com

Studio hours: Tue–Sat, 9am–6pm
